title: The Baffling Case of the 12-Inch Tongue

scenes.text: A tiger's tongue is covered in tiny, backward-facing spines called papillae
These spines help tigers scrape meat off bones and groom their fur

scenes.label: Tiger Tongue
scenes.text: The secret to a tiger's tongue is its unique texture

description: Discover the fascinating world of tiger tongues and their unique features. From their 12-inch length to their tiny, backward-facing spines, every aspect of a tiger's tongue is adapted for survival. Follow us for more mind-blowing animal facts!
